options.name: add_edns_option_in_outgoing_query
options.displayName: Add Edns Option In Outgoing Query
options.description: I(add_edns_option_in_outgoing_query) adds client IP, MAC address and view name into outgoing recursive query. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: auto_sort_views
options.description: Optional. Controls manual/automatic views ordering. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: comment
options.description: Optional. Comment for configuration.

options.name: custom_root_ns
options.description: Optional. List of custom root nameservers. The order does not matter. Error if empty while I(custom_root_ns_enabled) is I(true). Error if there are duplicate items in the list. Defaults to empty.

options.name: custom_root_ns_enabled
options.description: Optional. I(true) to use custom root nameservers instead of the default ones. The I(custom_root_ns) is validated when enabled. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: dnssec_enable_validation
options.description: Optional. I(true) to perform DNSSEC validation. Ignored if I(dnssec_enabled) is I(false). Defaults to I(true).

options.name: dnssec_enabled
options.description: Optional. Master toggle for all DNSSEC processing. Other I(dnssec)*_ configuration is unused if this is disabled. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: dnssec_trust_anchors
options.description: Optional. DNSSEC trust anchors. Error if there are list items with duplicate (I(zone), I(sep), I(algorithm)) combinations. Defaults to empty.

options.name: dnssec_validate_expiry
options.description: Optional. I(true) to reject expired DNSSEC keys. Ignored if either I(dnssec_enabled) or I(dnssec_enable_validation) is I(false). Defaults to I(true).

options.name: ecs_enabled
options.description: Optional. I(true) to enable EDNS client subnet for recursive queries. Other I(ecs)*_ fields are ignored if this field is not enabled. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: ecs_forwarding
options.description: Optional. I(true) to enable ECS options in outbound queries. This functionality has additional overhead so it is disabled by default. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: ecs_prefix_v4
options.description: Optional. Maximum scope length for v4 ECS. Unsigned integer, min 1 max 24 Defaults to 24.

options.name: ecs_prefix_v6
options.description: Optional. Maximum scope length for v6 ECS. Unsigned integer, min 1 max 56 Defaults to 56.

options.name: ecs_zones
options.description: Optional. List of zones where ECS queries may be sent. Error if empty while I(ecs_enabled) is I(true). Error if there are duplicate FQDNs in the list. Defaults to empty.

options.name: filter_aaaa_acl
options.description: Optional. Specifies a list of client addresses for which AAAA filtering is to be applied. Defaults to I(empty).

options.name: filter_aaaa_on_v4
options.description: I(filter_aaaa_on_v4) allows named to omit some IPv6 addresses when responding to IPv4 clients. Allowed values: * I(yes), * I(no), * I(break_dnssec). Defaults to I(no)

options.name: forwarders
options.description: Optional. List of forwarders. Error if empty while I(forwarders_only) or I(use_root_forwarders_for_local_resolution_with_b1td) is I(true). Error if there are items in the list with duplicate addresses. Defaults to empty.

options.name: forwarders_only
options.description: Optional. I(true) to only forward. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: gss_tsig_enabled
options.description: I(gss_tsig_enabled) enables/disables GSS-TSIG signed dynamic updates. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the object

options.name: inheritance_sources
options.description: Optional. Inheritance configuration.

options.name: kerberos_keys
options.description: I(kerberos_keys) contains a list of keys for GSS-TSIG signed dynamic updates. Defaults to empty.

options.name: lame_ttl
options.description: Optional. Unused in the current on-prem DNS server implementation. Unsigned integer, min 0 max 3600 (1h). Defaults to 600.

options.name: log_query_response
options.description: Optional. Control DNS query/response logging functionality. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: match_recursive_only
options.description: Optional. If I(true) only recursive queries from matching clients access the view. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: max_cache_ttl
options.description: Optional. Seconds to cache positive responses. Unsigned integer, min 1 max 604800 (7d). Defaults to 604800 (7d).

options.name: max_negative_ttl
options.description: Optional. Seconds to cache negative responses. Unsigned integer, min 1 max 604800 (7d). Defaults to 10800 (3h).

options.name: minimal_responses
options.description: Optional. When enabled, the DNS server will only add records to the authority and additional data sections when they are required. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: name
options.description: Name of configuration.

options.name: notify
options.description: I(notify) all external secondary DNS servers. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: portal_key
options.description: The API token for authentication against Infoblox BloxOne API. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_KEY) will be used.

options.name: portal_url
options.description: The Infoblox Cloud Services Portal (CSP) URL. If not set, the environment variable E(INFOBLOX_PORTAL_URL) will be used.

options.name: query_acl
options.description: Optional. Clients must match this ACL to make authoritative queries. Also used for recursive queries if that ACL is unset. Defaults to empty.

options.name: query_port
options.description: Optional. Source port for outbound DNS queries. When set to 0 the port is unspecified and the implementation may randomize it using any available ports. Defaults to 0.

options.name: recursion_acl
options.description: Optional. Clients must match this ACL to make recursive queries. If this ACL is empty, then the I(query_acl) field will be used instead. Defaults to empty.

options.name: recursion_enabled
options.description: Optional. I(true) to allow recursive DNS queries. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: recursive_clients
options.description: Optional. Defines the number of simultaneous recursive lookups the server will perform on behalf of its clients. Defaults to 1000.

options.name: resolver_query_timeout
options.description: Optional. Seconds before a recursive query times out. Unsigned integer, min 10 max 30. Defaults to 10.

options.name: secondary_axfr_query_limit
options.description: Optional. Maximum concurrent inbound AXFRs. When set to 0 a host-dependent default will be used. Defaults to 0.

options.name: secondary_soa_query_limit
options.description: Optional. Maximum concurrent outbound SOA queries. When set to 0 a host-dependent default will be used. Defaults to 0.

options.name: sort_list
options.description: Optional. Specifies a sorted network list for A/AAAA records in DNS query response. Defaults to I(empty).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the object

options.name: synthesize_address_records_from_https
options.description: I(synthesize_address_records_from_https) enables/disables creation of A/AAAA records from HTTPS RR Defaults to I(false).

options.name: tags
options.description: Tagging specifics.

options.name: transfer_acl
options.description: Optional. Clients must match this ACL to receive zone transfers. Defaults to empty.

options.name: update_acl
options.description: Optional. Specifies which hosts are allowed to issue Dynamic DNS updates for authoritative zones of I(primary_type) I(cloud). Defaults to empty.

options.name: use_forwarders_for_subzones
options.description: Optional. Use default forwarders to resolve queries for subzones. Defaults to I(true).

options.name: use_root_forwarders_for_local_resolution_with_b1td
options.displayName: Use Root Forwarders For Local Resolution With B1Td
options.description: I(use_root_forwarders_for_local_resolution_with_b1td) allows DNS recursive queries sent to root forwarders for local resolution when deployed alongside BloxOne Thread Defense. Defaults to I(false).

options.name: views
options.description: Optional. Ordered list of I(dns/display_view) objects served by any of I(dns/host) assigned to a particular DNS Config Profile. Automatically determined. Allows re-ordering only.
